core_contract_rule: Ego-side rewrites MUST emit at least task_id, verdict, claim_ceiling, and provenance/run_id when the run has one; new fields are additive, never redefinitions of observed corpus fields.

Does NOT test Bar-2 (fair Bayes/RL non-equivalence) or Bar-3 (subjectivity/emotion/consciousness). 'Looks alive' is not used as evidence.
